messages:
eva_support: FYI incoming ticket — user reports no free-trial credits after signup. They verified email and immediately added a card, but dashboard shows $0 credits. Account acct_01G3bH7, email masked: m***@examplecorp.com, region: EU (Ireland).
ravi_support: Thanks — can you paste the signup + payment timestamps and the card BIN? Need to check gating logs and payment review.
eva_support: signup_ts=1914999900, card_added_ts=1914999905, card_last4=4242, bin_country=US, user_ip_country=IE. Customer says they completed 3DS and email verify.
james_billing: Looking at payment provider logs — card auth succeeded but provider returned a "manual_review" status for 3DS metadata (risk_score=0.67). Our billing pipeline marks those as review and blocks auto-credit grants.
leo_ops: I pulled events from grants service: grant_workflow triggered on signup but then got a 409 from account-service when attaching payment method concurrently. The grant was marked as "pending_retry" and retry job didn't pick it up due to a flaky lock.
kyla_engineer: Noted — this matches a race we saw in staging where email verification + immediate payment attach can cause the grant job to abort. We have a fix branch but not yet deployed. Repro steps: 1) create account 2) verify email 3) attach card within 10s 4) observe grant_workflow -> 409 and no retry.
eva_support: Customer is asking for a timeline. Can we do a manual grant now?
james_billing: Yes. Suggest manual admin grant of 50 credits. I'll run after we confirm account and reason. Also mark as "fraud_review=false" for logging.
leo_ops: Before manual grant, confirm there's no active fraud hold. I checked fraud flags: account has "bin_country_mismatch=true" and "payment_manual_review=true" but no confirmed fraud. OK to grant with note.
eva_support: Go ahead, please post admin command you run so I can reference it to customer.
james_billing: Running admin tool now: `admin grant_credits --account acct_01G3bH7 --amount 50 --reason "manual grant - False positive payment/manual_review" --actor james_billing`
sys_bot: [audit] admin action by james_billing: grant_credits acct=acct_01G3bH7 amount=50 id=grant_072e9a2d timestamp=1915001200
eva_support: Confirmed on customer dashboard — credits now visible. Customer reports they can see new quota. Sending confirmation message. :tada:
ravi_support: Filing follow-up bug: GH-6421 "race: grant_workflow lost on concurrent payment attach". Assigning to @kyla_engineer, priority P1 for next patch. Add logs for 409 and improve retry window.
kyla_engineer: Got it. I'll add idempotent retries and expand the lock window; plan to cut a patch to staging today and prod tomorrow pending smoke tests.
leo_ops: Also adding a metric to alert if grant_workflow status stays in pending_retry > 5m for more than 3 accounts in 1m window.
james_billing: Suggested customer message: "Thanks — we've manually added your trial credits. We saw an internal gating flag triggered by the card's BIN country; no action required on your end. If you still see issues, reply here and we'll investigate"
eva_support: Sent message to customer and closed the ticket. Marking internal incident = support-credits-2026-03-17. :white_check_mark:
